addressConvention: Function and call-site addresses are image-base-normalized RVAs used by xivl-decomp. Add image base 0x00400000 for the loaded VA.
scope: Retail controller, keyboard, and mouse input routing relevant to an XInput-only runtime hook.

verdict.claim: XInput and DirectInput are both live controller backends. DirectInput8 enumerates every game-controller record; WMI classification routes each record to XInput or DirectInput state polling. Mixed records are polled in the same Application::Rapture update, so an XInput-only hook cannot observe or control DirectInput-routed gamepads. Keyboard and mouse use ordinary window messages and USER32 state/cursor APIs, not DirectInput or Raw Input.

rawInput.boundedAbsence: The PE import table contains no RegisterRawInputDevices, GetRawInputData, GetRawInputBuffer, GetRawInputDeviceInfo, or GetRawInputDeviceList entry. The frozen exact-string inventory contains none of those names.

otherControllerApis.boundedAbsence: The PE has no HID import and no WINMM joyGetPos, joyGetPosEx, joyGetDevCaps, or joyGetNumDevs import.

dynamicLoadAudit.claim: No alternate input DLL or input entry point is named for LoadLibrary/GetProcAddress resolution. The only frozen input-DLL/API strings are the normal import-descriptor names DINPUT8.dll, XINPUT1_3.dll, and DirectInput8Create; the PE has no delay-import directory.
dynamicLoadAudit.ceiling: INSUFFICIENT-DATA for an input API name assembled, decrypted, or received only at runtime. Generic LoadLibrary and GetProcAddress imports exist for unrelated subsystems.

application.behavior: Constructs PadDevice, MouseDevice, and KeyboardDevice at object offsets +0x40, +0x44, and +0x48.

directInput.behavior: Calls DirectInput8Create with version 0x0800 and IID bf798030-483a-4da2-aa99-5d64ed369700 (IDirectInput8A), then stores the shared interface at global RVA 0x01378680.

controllerEnumeration.behavior: Calls XInputEnable(TRUE), then IDirectInput8A::EnumDevices with device class 4 (DI8DEVCLASS_GAMECTRL), callback FUN_00D33180, and flags 1.

enumerationCallback.behavior: Creates or queries every DirectInput-enumerated game-controller device, calls FUN_00D32100 with the product GUID Data1, and stores one exclusive backend flag per controller record.

classifier.behavior: Queries WMI namespace \\.\root\cimv2 and class Win32_PNPEntity, reads DeviceID, requires an IG_ marker, parses VID_ and PID_, combines PID << 16 | VID, and compares that value with the DirectInput product GUID Data1 at 0x0093230E.
classifier.xinputResult: A matching IG_ record is marked XInput and its temporary DirectInput device is released after metadata collection.
classifier.directInputResult: A nonmatching record, or a WMI setup/query/match failure, is routed to DirectInput. The client calls SetCooperativeLevel at 0x0093338F with flags 9 (exclusive, background), SetDataFormat at 0x009333AE, EnumObjects at 0x009333D1, and Acquire at 0x009335E7.

controllerRouting.selectionModel: Backend selection is mutually exclusive per device record but concurrent across records. It is capability/identity classification, not a first-failure fallback order.

noXinputFallback.claim: An XInputGetState failure clears that record's state. The poll function contains no edge from that failure to DirectInput Poll/GetDeviceState for the same record.

padUpdate.behavior: Iterates all enumerated records during one call. A marked record calls XInputGetState at 0x0093385B. Every unmarked live record optionally calls IDirectInputDevice8A::Poll at 0x00933D86 and calls GetDeviceState with size 0x94 at 0x00933D9E.
padUpdate.coexistence: A mixed XInput and DirectInput record set therefore invokes both state APIs in the same Application::Rapture update and on the same invoking thread.

cadence.claim: Application::Rapture slot 1 is the common application update and is the retail per-frame poll candidate.
cadence.ceiling: INSUFFICIENT-DATA for an exact one-call-per-rendered-frame guarantee or measured poll frequency from statics alone.

controllers.path: DirectInput8 game-controller enumeration followed by per-record XInput or DirectInput polling.

keyboard.path: Window-subclass keyboard messages plus GetKeyboardState and ToAscii. DirectInput is not used.

mouse.path: Window-subclass mouse messages plus capture, cursor-position, and screen-to-client USER32 calls. DirectInput is not used.

rawInput.path: No imported, named dynamic, or inspected input-callback WM_INPUT route was found.

focus.controllerBehavior: FUN_00D337A0 compares GetActiveWindow with the game HWND before polling unless object +0xA4 permits background input. The inactive path clears normalized controller state and skips both XInput and DirectInput polling; it does not switch backends.
focus.keyboardMouseBehavior: The subclass callbacks clear state on deactivation and menu or size-move entry. Mouse position polling also requires the active game window.

reenumeration.behavior: FUN_00D337A0 calls FUN_00D33630 after 0x96 update cycles when no record succeeds or the selected-index field remains zero. FUN_00D34410 also exposes an explicit reconfiguration path.

deviceMessages.boundedAbsence: The inspected keyboard and mouse subclass callbacks contain no WM_DEVICECHANGE or WM_INPUT case, and the input import/name inventory exposes no registration route for either mechanism.

switching.claim: Focus loss clears or suppresses state; it never changes the stored per-record XInput/DirectInput selection. Re-enumeration can rebuild and reclassify records.

sharedPollContext.claim: Pad, mouse, and keyboard slot-2 updates are synchronous calls from one FUN_004B3C50 invocation. XInput and DirectInput record polls therefore share that invocation's thread.

osThreadIdentity.stoppingPoint: Application::Rapture::vftable slot 1 -> FUN_004B3C50. Its upper caller is polymorphic framework dispatch and is not resolved by the direct static call graph.
osThreadIdentity.residue: Record OS thread IDs at FUN_004B3C50, XInputGetState, DirectInput Poll/GetDeviceState, and the window-subclass callbacks in a real-client run.

launcherHookDisposition.answer: No. An XInput-only runtime hook is complete only when every active controller record is classified as IG_ XInput. Any non-IG_ game controller bypasses the hook through IDirectInputDevice8A::Poll/GetDeviceState. A WMI classification failure also selects the DirectInput route. Mixed records can exercise both routes in the same update.
launcherHookDisposition.minimumCoverage: Hook both XInputGetState and the DirectInput device Poll/GetDeviceState route, or hook the post-normalization PadDevice state after FUN_00D337A0 has merged either backend.

liveValidationResidue.task: Run one IG_ XInput pad and one non-IG_ DirectInput pad together; log XInputGetState and IDirectInputDevice8A Poll/GetDeviceState to confirm simultaneous retail behavior and selection semantics.
Hotplug each class while another controller remains active; measure when the 0x96-cycle re-enumeration condition fires and whether any unobserved external reconfiguration call accelerates it.
Alt-tab and restore while logging both backends, stored selection flags, and normalized pad state; confirm suppression without backend switching under the retail configuration.
Record poll cadence and OS thread IDs on native Windows, Wine, and Steam Input. Static retail routing does not predict platform shim behavior.

residualCeilings: The upper virtual caller and exact OS thread identity of Application::Rapture slot 1 are unresolved.
Exact render-frame coupling and measured input-poll cadence require runtime instrumentation.
Hotplug behavior while another record remains healthy is not fixed by the observed counter condition alone.
Runtime-generated API names and platform translation layers remain outside the bounded PE import/string audit.
Windows, Wine, and Steam Input can present different device identities or shims and require the owner's real-client matrix.
